name: Sydney
housing: Sydney renters mostly live in units in walk-up blocks and apartment towers, plus older terrace houses in the inner city.

localRules.text: In NSW the bond must be lodged with NSW Fair Trading, and landlords must offer tenants the Rental Bonds Online service.
The NSW condition report, signed at move-in, is the key evidence when the bond is claimed at the end of the tenancy.

tenantHelp.name: Tenants' Union of NSW
tenantHelp.what: free tenancy advice and information in NSW

climate: Test the air conditioning or fans and check for mould in bathrooms; Sydney summers are hot and humid.
fact: Most Sydney renters live in units rather than houses.
